fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2025-07-05, a disagreement over a boundary issue turned into a scuffle involving Thirumal Sekar near Roja Park Main Street. The time of the incident was given as 23:55 on 2025-07-05. Kannan Thangaraj (9000000206) reported the matter for Thirumal Sekar, whose contact number is given as 9000000046. A further person, Siva Muthu, an intermediary, using the number 9000000256, is stated to be associated with the incident. Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Senthil Krishnan, using the number 9000000461. The complainant mentioned photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
